summary: Ticket #824: runners and routines read the published brief snapshot instead of running a live brief. Added `funnel snapshot`, an offline subcommand printing the newest dashboard spool entry byte-for-byte (no Project load); routines/zcode.md and routines/claude.md breakdown sections now read `.brief.awaiting_breakdown` from it, and skills/funnel/SKILL.md (/funnel) renders `.brief` plus snapshot age. Removed the fail-closed brief gate (BRIEF_GATE_SECTIONS, BriefGateTimeout, candidate counts): every over-budget section degrades into an explicit `degraded` record while the rest of the brief still emits and spools. Updated the two gate tests to the degrade-explicitly behavior, added tests/test_snapshot.py (6 tests), a no-live-brief-invocation guard over scripts/ and routines/, a /funnel-reads-snapshot skill test, and repasted both routine SHAs. Full suite: 1747 passed, 1 skipped; 8 errors in untouched subprocess-heavy tests (muse-implement/review-engine/run-keeper/watchdog-calibration) are full-run-only flakes that pass standalone and grouped and do not touch changed code. Dashboard JS: 10 passed.
